title: Paw Wars
tagline: Run contraband in a world where dogs make the rules.
body: Paw Wars takes place in a world where dogs are the ruling class and cats are treated as lower class citizens. Luxury items are strictly forbidden, but a black market persists. You take on the role of a smuggler trying to provide contraband to cats in need. Travel the world buying and selling, dodge the police, and hustle to get rich or die trying.
